data.name: Principal.Confirmar.ModemDetalle
data.value:
“{0}” is about to be transmitted.
An FT8 period is THIRTEEN SECONDS with the radio on air, without a break.
Make sure an antenna or a dummy load is connected and that the clock is right: with a drifting clock you transmit outside the window and disturb other stations without noticing.
Transmission is supervised: it releases by itself if something goes wrong, and the “RELEASE PTT” button stops it at any time.

Transmission is supervised: it releases by itself if something goes wrong, and the “RELEASE PTT” button stops it at any time.
